description: This file is a shell script used for bumping kernel versions within an OpenWrt development environment. It includes functions for handling git operations, version management, and recommendations for upgrading kernel files in a platform-specific manner. The script also handles command-line options and environment variables to facilitate automation of kernel version updates.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script, outlining the command-line options available.

methods.name: check_requirements
methods.description: Verifies the presence of required external commands and reports any missing dependencies.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that orchestrates option parsing, preliminary checks, and execution of kernel bumping logic.

methods.name: bump_kernel
methods.description: Performs the process of updating kernel version files, managing git operations, and restoring the repository state post-update.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes environment variables, verifies repository state, and validates script location before proceeding.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Restores the original git branch and cleans up temporary states created during the script execution.
